move: lane draws around track as digits roll 3-2-1, lime flash
how: An SVG stadium track eases from scale 1.3 rotation -6 to 0.9 / 4 linearly across D. The highlighted lane path draws with DrawSVG 0→100% over 3.2s with power1.inOut while a runner dot follows it with MotionPath. Kicker and footer rise from masks. Digits 3, 2, 1 each slam in from yPercent 110 and scale 1.4 with expo.out at 0.05D, 0.3D and 0.55D, then roll out upward with expo.in 0.85s later. At 0.8D a lime .flash fills the frame in 0.12s, GO lands from scale 1.6 with expo.out, grows to 1.1, then the flash and GO fade out so the frame is dark again for the loop.
adapt: Change the kicker/footer strings, the digit sequence and GO word, the track colours and the lane path; keep the 1s digit cadence, the 3.2s draw and the 0.12s flash.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the track SVG with .lane and .runner, .flash, .kick, .num digits, .go and .foot; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with DrawSVGPlugin and MotionPathPlugin registered and offsets as fractions of D (digits 0.2/4 + i, GO 3.2/4). Scope selectors to el; the motionPath path reference must point at el's .lane.
caveats: the runner dot is on screen at t=0 at the lane start, so the track state at the end (scale 0.9, rot 4) differs from the start (1.3, -6)
